text.tspan: School Finance Management | proposed operating flow
Editable Excalidraw map for Finance, Fees, Accounts and the school payment journey
Administrator confirms school settings; the system checks readiness before money moves.
The finance officer works in Fees; payment verification and bank matching live in Accounts.
Every fee action updates Student Accounts and creates one auditable financial event.
Waiver stays within Collections. Refund stays within Fees. Their accounting entries are automatic.
The finance officer records business facts; accountants review journals, exceptions and close periods.
Refund is not an Expense voucher
Post balanced debit and credit lines
Only blocked or failed automatic postings
Aarav, Grade 8 | Accrual posting when the fee demand is raised
No new fee income is recorded.
Student pays INR 5,000; due is INR 4,000.
This is a liability payout, not school expense.
Student advance: INR 0; UPI clearing: INR 0.
Net fee income after concession: INR 14,000.
Net cash and bank receipt: INR 14,000.
Source -> policy -> financial event -> balanced journal -> ledger -> reconciliation.
